API header for [SKSE Menu Framework 3](https://github.com/QTR-Modding/SKSE-Menu-Framework-3), copied unchanged from
[QTR-Modding/SKSE-Menu-Framework-3-API](https://github.com/QTR-Modding/SKSE-Menu-Framework-3-API)
at commit 1dcb70179076aae4ab626f43c5baab2735ca5877. It's under the LGPL-2.1 (`LICENSE` here).

The header only calls into `SKSEMenuFramework.dll` when that's loaded, so the menu is optional.
